note: Airport staff as individuals (docs/DESIGN_REVISION_4.md 6.4, T68 proposals). Minutes and hours are game time.

roles.note: Saved index order, append only. sprites: staff recipe ids of people.json.

stations.note: Fixture key: role and officers on duty. needByLevel, when given, replaces need per fixture level 1 to 3 (T74). unstaffedFactor, when given, is the share of its rate a station serves with nobody on it (T81), else it stops.

shifts.note: Start hours of the three shifts, length in hours, clock in or out minutes, longest wait for a relief past the shift end.

breaks.note: One break per shift: due afterMin plus 0 to jitterMin after the shift start, lengthMin at the staff center, reliefWaitMin before leaving without a relief, tiredSkill without a staff center.

operator.note: Where on duty staff stand: metres behind the fixture anchor centre, away from the queue, and side spacing.

ramp.note: Apron crews (T81): a pool at the lowest id ground handling depot needing crewSize per commercial stand with a road; each airline turnaround holds one crew from chocks to door close.

cleaning.note: Terminal rooms (T81): each passenger in a room adds dirtPerPersonMin units a game minute, counted every everyMin minutes, a room is fully dirty at dirtyPerM2 units per m2, a cleaner of the nearest janitor room is called at callShare and cleans for cleanBaseMin plus cleanMinPer100M2 per 100 m2.
